facts.text: A store whose policy does not give a full cash or credit refund, or an equal exchange, for at least 7 days after purchase (with proof of purchase) must conspicuously display that policy.
facts.quote: for at least seven days following purchase of the goods if they are returned and proof of their purchase is presented, shall conspicuously display that policy

facts.text: The displayed policy must state whether cash refunds, store credit, or exchanges are given, the time period, covered merchandise types, and other conditions.
facts.quote: This display shall state the store’s policy, including, but not limited to, whether cash refund, store credit, or exchanges will be given for the full amount of the purchase price; the applicable time period; the types of merchandise which are covered by the policy; and any other conditions which govern the refund, credit, or exchange of merchandise.

facts.text: Certain goods are exempt from this refund policy requirement, including food, plants, perishable goods, goods marked 'as is' or 'no returns accepted', used or damaged goods, customized goods, goods without original packaging, and goods that cannot be resold due to health reasons.
facts.quote: This section does not apply to food, plants, flowers, perishable goods, goods marked “as is,” “no returns accepted,” “all sales final,” or with similar language, goods used or damaged after purchase, customized goods received as ordered, goods not returned with their original package, and goods which cannot be resold due to health considerations.

facts.text: If a retail store violates this section, it is liable to the buyer for the purchase amount if the buyer returns or attempts to return the goods within 30 days of purchase.
facts.quote: Any retail store which violates this section shall be liable to the buyer for the amount of the purchase if the buyer returns, or attempts to return, the purchased goods on or before the 30th day after their purchase.

facts.text: Violations of this section are subject to remedies under the Consumers Legal Remedies Act.
facts.quote: Violations of this section shall be subject to the remedies provided in the Consumers Legal Remedies Act (Title 1.5 (commencing with Section 1750) of Part 4).

facts.text: The rights and remedies in this section are in addition to other state law rights and remedies.
facts.quote: The duties, rights, and remedies provided in this section are in addition to any other duties, rights, and remedies provided by state law.
